name: Gayatri Rubbers & Chemicals Ltd.
summary: Gayatri Rubbers & Chemicals Ltd. manufactures and trades diverse rubber products and chemicals, including rubber profiles, rubber compounds, auto glass rubber, and sponge rubber for heavy industries. The company supplies specialized rubber products and components to various sectors such as automotive, architectural, industrial, railway, and defense. Specifically, it caters to automotive OEMs and aftermarket, provides rubber for building construction including aluminum window and door profiles, and serves electrical meter, packing, engineering, and power transmission industries. Furthermore, it supplies to Indian railways, metros, and the Ministry of Defense. Operating on a business-to-business model with a focus on customized manufacturing, the company primarily serves the domestic Indian market. Additionally, Gayatri Rubbers & Chemicals Ltd. has ventured into the smart meter industry, producing smart meters, RMC switch gears, and SMC enclosures.
